code='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    background = set(grid[0])\n    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row if value not in background)\n    color = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]\n    return [[color] * 3 for _ in range(3)]\n'''
